content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Diversified holding company; billboards are one segment alongside broadband and insurance, so its multiple reflects a different mix."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Sells ad space on billboards, transit and airport displays to brands and agencies, matching OUTFRONT's core business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Customer experience outsourcing and tech services; it runs support operations rather than selling advertising space."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Organizes B2B trade shows and earns booth and sponsorship fees; no advertising display inventory."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Truckload freight hauling for shippers; a transportation business with no advertising inventory."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Truckload, intermodal and brokerage freight services; a transportation business, not advertising."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Publishes news, books and property portals, earning subscriptions and reader revenue rather than leasing display space."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Agency network selling creative, media and PR services on client fees; it does not own or operate ad displays."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants; real estate rather than advertising displays."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Owns suburban shopping centers and leases store space to retailers; real estate, not advertising."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Marketing and agency services sold on fees to brands; it does not own advertising display inventory."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Radio and cable broadcaster selling audience airtime; different media format from out-of-home displays."}]}
